title: Rideau Acres Campground

services.name: Our Campground
services.desc: Rideau Acres features large spacious campsites with gravel pads. We have 30 and 50 amp full service sites available with pull thru driveways. Group and Rally Sites - We cater to small and large groups. Let us help you plan a rally in Kingston. We can provide meals of almost any kind, including outdoor barbecues. We can also help you with your entertainment and attraction selection. Kingston and the region offer Thousand Island cruises, live theatre, museum tours, and all sorts of water related activities.
